class.name: NetwMultiplayer
class.brief_description: The [MultiplayerAPI] implementation for a Networked session.
class.description:
Use [method Netw.of] to get it for a node. Its methods take the [RID] of an object such as a [NetwEntity] or a [NetwScene], and most game code uses those objects instead. [codeblock] var api := Netw.of(self) api.entity_despawn(NetwEntity.of(self).rid) api.scene_watch(Netw.scene(self).rid, peer_id) [/codeblock] Each method prefix matches the class that wraps it. - [code]scene_*[/code]: [NetwScene] - [code]interest_*[/code]: [NetwInterest] - [code]session_*[/code]: [NetwSession] - [code]clock_*[/code]: [NetwClock] - [code]predict_*[/code]: [NetwPrediction] - [code]entity_*[/code], [code]liveness_*[/code], and [code]spawn_*[/code]: [NetwEntity] - [code]table_*[/code]: [NetwTable] - [code]schema_*[/code]: [NetwSchema] - [code]lagcomp_*[/code]: [NetwAction] - [code]peer_*[/code]: [NetwPlayer] - [code]display_*[/code]: [NetwDisplay] - [code]endpoint_*[/code]: [NetwConnection] - [code]transport_*[/code]: [NetwTransport] - [code]rpc_*[/code] and [code]sync_*[/code]: [NetwMemberConfig] - [code]service_*[/code]: [NetwService] - [code]database_*[/code] and [code]persist_*[/code]: [NetwDatabase] and [NetwPersistence] - [code]stats_*[/code] and [code]attribution_*[/code]: [NetwPredictStats] Methods beginning with an underscore are virtual. Override one in a script and call the matching [code]_default[/code] method to run the default behavior. [codeblock] extends NetwMultiplayer
func _predict_consume( depth: int, buffer: int) -> NetwPrediction.ConsumeAction: if depth > 8: return NetwPrediction.CONSUME_ACTION_REPLAY return predict_consume_default(depth, buffer) [/codeblock] Create the subclass with [code]new()[/code] and set it as [member MultiplayerViewport.api], or pass it to [method SceneTree.set_multiplayer]. [code]super[/code] does not work on these methods, so call the [code]_default[/code] method. Only a GDScript subclass can override them.

method.name: _display_write_rows
method.description: Draws the interpolated value of one property for every entity in [param routes], for the property declaration [param table] names. [param column] is the property's index in [param table], and [param values] holds one value per route. [method store_describe] lists the tables. A value no table holds, such as an interpolated argument of a remote call, arrives with an invalid [param table], and [param column] is then the index of the value among the entity's interpolated values. Return [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] to let the display write the node itself. With no override this returns [method display_write_rows_default].

method.name: _persist_tick
method.description: Saves persistent entities. [method MultiplayerAPI.poll] calls it with [param delta], the seconds since the last poll. Override it to decide when to save, and call [method persist_tick_default] to save.

method.name: _predict_admit_frame
method.description: Accepts or rejects an incoming prediction packet. Return [constant @GlobalScope.OK] to accept it. With no override this returns [method predict_admit_frame_default].

method.name: _predict_consume
method.description: Decides what the authority does with a predicted entity's input queue, called once per tick. [param depth] is how many inputs are queued and [param buffer] is how many it should hold. With no override this returns [method predict_consume_default].

method.name: _predict_drive
method.description: Picks which input a predicted entity simulates this frame. [param latest_input_tick] is the newest input it holds, [param last_driven_input_tick] is the last one it simulated, and [param frame_tick] is the tick to use when it holds none. With no override this returns [method predict_drive_default]. Returning [code]null[/code] emits [constant EVENT_SEAM_MISUSE] and the default is used.

method.name: _predict_evaluate
method.description: Decides whether a predicted state matches the state the authority sent. [param predicted] and [param payload] are the two states. With no override this returns [method predict_evaluate_default]. Returning [code]null[/code] emits [constant EVENT_SEAM_MISUSE] and the default is used.

method.name: _predict_recover
method.description: Decides how a mispredicted entity is corrected to the authority's state. [param payload] is the authority's state, [param predicted] is the local prediction for the same tick, [param current] is the local state now, and [param policy] is [method NetwPrediction.resolved_recovery_policy]. With no override this returns [method predict_recover_default]. Returning [code]null[/code] emits [constant EVENT_SEAM_MISUSE] and the default is used.

method.name: _spawn_admit_frame
method.description: Accepts or rejects an incoming spawn packet. Return [constant @GlobalScope.OK] to accept it. With no override this returns [method spawn_admit_frame_default].

method.name: _spawn_construct
method.description: Creates the node for an entity the server spawned on this peer. Return the node without adding it to the tree. With no override this returns [method spawn_construct_default]. Override it to pool nodes or pick a different scene.

method.name: _spawn_declare
method.description: Allows [param entity] to be spawned on other peers. It does not spawn it. [param recipe] is what a remote peer needs to create the node, and holds plain values only. With no override this returns [method spawn_declare_default].

method.name: _spawn_undeclare
method.description: Called when [param entity] can no longer be spawned on other peers. Copies peers already hold stay. The default does nothing.

method.name: _sync_admit_frame
method.description: Accepts or rejects an incoming synchronization packet. Return [constant @GlobalScope.OK] to accept it. With no override this returns [method sync_admit_frame_default].

method.name: _sync_apply_rows
method.description: Writes the received replicated property values of every entity in [param routes] into its node, for the property declaration [param table] names. [method store_describe] lists the tables. [param routes] holds the entities whose received values are due now. A row that arrives is due at once, unless the entity's simulation runs a buffered replica copy, which takes it when the display tick reaches it. [codeblock lang=text] Array ┖╴column Array one per property in declaration order, one value per route [/codeblock] An override is the only writer of these properties on every peer, a remote proxy included. With no override this returns [method sync_apply_rows_default].

method.name: _sync_decode
method.description: Decodes a received synchronization [param payload] for [param entity]. It reads what [method _sync_encode] wrote on the sender, so override both together. Return an error to drop the packet without changing the node. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the values are applied ┖╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED no decoder exists for this entity [/codeblock]

method.name: _sync_encode
method.description: Returns the synchronization payload sent to [param peer] on [param tick]. An empty array sends nothing. [method _sync_decode] reads it on the other side, so override both together.

method.name: _sync_gather_rows
method.description: Reads the replicated property values of every entity in [param routes], once per tick for each property declaration [param table] names. Entities share a [param table] when their nodes declare the same replicated properties, and [method store_describe] lists them. [param routes] holds only the entities whose values may have changed. An entity whose rigid body slept through this tick and the last one is left out. [codeblock lang=text] Array ┖╴row Array one per route in order, the values in declaration order [/codeblock] A row of the wrong size keeps that entity's previous values and sends nothing for it this tick. With no override this returns [method sync_gather_rows_default].

method.name: _sync_note_ack
method.description: Called when [param peer] acknowledges every packet up to [param sequence]. The counts feed [method peer_link_stats]. With no override this calls [method sync_note_ack_default].

method.name: _sync_note_sent
method.description: Called when packet [param sequence] is sent to [param peer]. With no override this calls [method sync_note_sent_default]. An override that skips the default drops what the packet carried.

method.name: _table_admit_frame
method.description: Accepts or rejects an incoming table packet. Return [constant @GlobalScope.OK] to accept it. With no override this returns [method table_admit_frame_default].

method.name: attribution_is_armed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [method attribution_set_armed] turned on per-column counting.

method.name: attribution_set_armed
method.description: Turns on counting bits per synchronized property, read from [method attribution_snapshot] under [code]columns[/code]. The count is each property's declared size, which can be larger than what compression actually sent. It works in release builds.

method.name: attribution_snapshot
method.description: Returns where this session's bandwidth went. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴bytes_out Dictionary peer -> channel -> bytes sent ┠╴bytes_in Dictionary peer -> channel -> bytes received ┠╴route_bytes_out Dictionary route -> bytes sent ┠╴route_bytes_in Dictionary route -> bytes received ┠╴attributed_out int the sum of bytes_out ┠╴attributed_in int the sum of bytes_in ┠╴framing_out int counted as sent, carrying no frame ┠╴frames_out int frames sent ┠╴frames_in int frames received ┠╴staged_dropped_out int bytes encoded and never sent ┠╴frames_in_by_channel Dictionary peer -> channel -> frames received ┠╴refused_in int frames rejected on arrival ┠╴refusals Dictionary peer -> channel -> rejection name -> count ┠╴armed bool whether column grain is being recorded ┠╴columns Dictionary a packed key -> schema, column, bits ┖╴residual Dictionary the same bytes at the datagram boundary [/codeblock] Route [code]0[/code] is traffic that belongs to no entity. [code]residual[/code] counts the same traffic including packet headers, with this shape. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴datagram_bytes_out int what sent_bytes holds ┠╴attributed_out int the sum of bytes_out ┠╴framing_out int sent bytes carrying no frame ┠╴staged_dropped_out int bytes encoded and never sent ┠╴residual_out int sent bytes neither table claims ┠╴datagram_bytes_in int what received_bytes holds ┠╴attributed_in int the sum of bytes_in ┠╴residual_in int the envelopes around those payloads ┠╴wire_bytes_out int whole datagrams given the transport ┠╴wire_bytes_in int whole datagrams taken from it ┠╴datagrams_out int how many of those went out ┠╴datagrams_in int how many came in ┠╴carrier_overhead_out int datagram headers written ┖╴carrier_overhead_in int those headers plus the envelopes [/codeblock]

method.name: auth_set_app_tag
method.description: Sets a build number that peers must share to connect. [code]0[/code] accepts any build.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the replication state of the wrapped [member inner] [SceneMultiplayer]. Players, services and entities are kept.

method.name: clear_roster
method.description: Forgets every peer and player, including [member local_player]. Nobody is disconnected. [method peer_forget] does the same for one peer.

method.name: clock_auto_configure_offset
method.description: Measures the connection for five seconds, then sets [constant CLOCK_PARAM_DISPLAY_OFFSET] to the largest value [method clock_get_recommended_display_offset] returned. Does nothing on the server.

method.name: clock_get_config
method.description: Returns a copy of the current clock settings. Changing the copy has no effect.

method.name: clock_get_display_tick
method.description: The tick to render, which is [method clock_get_tick] minus [constant CLOCK_PARAM_DISPLAY_OFFSET], never below zero.

method.name: clock_get_monitor
method.description: Returns one clock diagnostic value.

method.name: clock_get_param
method.description: Returns the current value of one clock setting, as an [int], [float] or [bool] depending on the setting.

method.name: clock_get_physics_factor
method.description: Physics frames per tick, unrounded. 60 physics ticks per second with a [constant CLOCK_PARAM_TICKRATE] of 30 returns [code]2.0[/code].

method.name: clock_get_physics_steps_per_tick
method.description: [method clock_get_physics_factor] rounded to a whole number, never below one.

method.name: clock_get_recommended_display_offset
method.description: The display offset this connection needs, in ticks. It is the one-way latency plus the jitter times [constant CLOCK_PARAM_JITTER_MULTIPLIER], rounded up. It is not applied. [method clock_auto_configure_offset] applies it.

method.name: clock_get_simulation_behind_count
method.description: How many frames skipped a tick because the clock runs at most one tick per frame. A count that keeps growing means this machine is too slow to keep up with [constant CLOCK_PARAM_TICKRATE].

method.name: clock_get_tick
method.description: The current server-calibrated simulation tick.

method.name: clock_get_tick_factor
method.description: How far time has moved past the last tick, as a fraction of a tick. Use it to interpolate between ticks. [constant CLOCK_PARAM_TICK_FACTOR_OVERRIDE] replaces it with a fixed value.

method.name: clock_get_tick_phase
method.description: How far into the current tick the clock is, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: clock_ingest_pong
method.description: Adjusts the local tick toward the server's using one round-trip [param sample], in seconds. [constant NetwClock.SYNC_MODE_SNAP] corrects at once, and [constant NetwClock.SYNC_MODE_STRETCH] corrects a little each frame until the difference passes [constant CLOCK_PARAM_PANIC_SNAP_THRESHOLD]. Returns the same [Dictionary] [constant CLOCK_PONG_RECEIVED] carries. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴rtt_raw float this sample's round trip, in seconds ┠╴rtt_avg float the running average round trip ┠╴rtt_jitter float the running jitter estimate ┠╴diff int ticks the calibration moved this peer ┠╴tick int the tick after calibrating ┠╴display_offset float the offset the display is running ┠╴recommended_display_offset float the offset this sample recommends ┠╴is_stable bool whether jitter is under threshold ┖╴is_synchronized bool whether a calibration has ever landed [/codeblock]

method.name: clock_is_configured
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a [NetwClockConfig] was applied. Without one the tick does not move.

method.name: clock_is_gated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while [method clock_set_gate] is on.

method.name: clock_is_simulating
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when physics may step this frame. Always [code]true[/code] unless [method clock_set_gate] is on.

method.name: clock_is_stable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [constant NetwClock.CLOCK_MONITOR_RTT_JITTER] is below [constant CLOCK_PARAM_JITTER_STABILITY_THRESHOLD].

method.name: clock_is_synchronized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the clock has synchronized with the server at least once.

method.name: clock_physics_step
method.description: Advances the clock by [param delta] seconds and runs every tick that completes. The session calls it every physics frame unless [constant CLOCK_PARAM_MANUAL_TICK] is set. A frame longer than [constant CLOCK_PARAM_STALL_THRESHOLD] is skipped, and no frame runs more than [constant CLOCK_PARAM_MAX_TICKS_PER_FRAME] ticks.

method.name: clock_request_handshake
method.description: Asks the server for its tickrate. [method clock_set_mismatch_action] decides what happens when it differs. The session calls this on clients when they connect.

method.name: clock_send_ping
method.description: Sends an unreliable ping to the server. The reply notifies [constant CLOCK_PONG_RECEIVED].

method.name: clock_set_gate
method.description: While on, physics steps only on frames that have a tick to run, so a tick covers the same physics time on every peer. A client runs at most one tick a frame while it is on, so its tick snaps to the server's when it falls further behind than the [constant CLOCK_PARAM_MAX_TICKS_PER_FRAME] setting allows a frame to catch up. [method clock_is_simulating] tells whether this frame steps. Calls nest, so it turns off when every [code]true[/code] is matched by a [code]false[/code].

method.name: clock_set_mismatch_action
method.description: Sets what happens when the server's tickrate differs from this peer's. The default is [constant NetwClock.MISMATCH_ACTION_WARN].

method.name: clock_set_param
method.description: Changes one clock setting. The tickrate can only be set with [method Netw.configure_clock]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the setting changed ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED param was CLOCK_PARAM_TICKRATE ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER param is unknown [/codeblock]

method.name: clock_set_synchronized
method.description: Sets [method clock_is_synchronized]. Set it to [code]false[/code] to resynchronize from scratch on the next ping.

method.name: clock_step
method.description: Runs [param count] ticks immediately. It does not notify [constant CLOCK_BEFORE_TICK_LOOP]. Wrap it in [method clock_tick_loop] when that is needed.

method.name: clock_tick_loop
method.description: Notifies [constant CLOCK_BEFORE_TICK_LOOP] when [param open] is [code]true[/code], and [constant CLOCK_AFTER_TICK_LOOP] otherwise. Predicted entities only run between the two.

method.name: complete_auth
method.description: Same as [method SceneMultiplayer.complete_auth]. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED] when there is no [member inner].

method.name: core_of
method.description: Returns the [NetwMultiplayer] that [param node] belongs to.

method.name: database_close
method.description: Closes [param database] once its pending operations finish. The promise resolves with an [enum @GlobalScope.Error], see [method NetwDatabase.close].

method.name: database_create
method.description: Declares a database named [param name] from [param config] and returns its [RID]. A name already declared returns the [RID] it has, or an invalid one when [param config] names a different backend.

method.name: database_delete_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot] and everything stored in it. Can be called before [method database_open]. Deleting the open slot fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY]. See [method NetwDatabase.delete_slot] for the errors.

method.name: database_erase
method.description: Removes the record at [param id]. Erasing a record that is not there succeeds. See [method NetwDatabase.erase] for the errors.

method.name: database_find
method.description: The database declared as [param name], or an invalid [RID] when none is.

method.name: database_flush
method.description: Resolves once every operation started on [param database] before this call has finished. See [method NetwDatabase.flush] for the errors.

method.name: database_get_slot
method.description: The slot [param database] holds open, or empty when it is not open.

method.name: database_get_state
method.description: Whether [param database] is closed, opening, open, closing or faulted, as a [enum DatabaseState].

method.name: database_list_slots
method.description: Lists every slot stored in [param database], see [method NetwDatabase.list_slots]. Can be called before [method database_open].

method.name: database_open
method.description: Opens [param slot]. Other operations fail until the promise resolves. Opening a different slot while one is open fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY]. See [method NetwDatabase.open] for the errors.

method.name: database_patch
method.description: Writes the fields in [param values] to the record at [param id] and keeps the rest. A missing record fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. See [method NetwDatabase.patch] for the errors.

method.name: database_read
method.description: Reads the record at [param id], see [method NetwDatabase.read] for the result. [param schema] is a sealed schema, such as one from [method schema_find]. A [param database] that is not open fails the promise with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED], an unsealed [param schema] with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST], and an empty [param id] with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: database_scan
method.description: Reads up to [param limit] records matching [param filter], see [method NetwDatabase.scan] for the result. Pass an empty [param cursor] to start, and the cursor of the previous page to continue.

method.name: database_submit
method.description: Applies [param operations] in order, see [method NetwWriteBatch.submit] for the result. Build [param operations] with [NetwWriteBatch].

method.name: database_write
method.description: Replaces the whole record at [param id]. [param values] must hold every column [param schema] declares and nothing else. See [method NetwDatabase.write] for the errors.

method.name: disconnect_peer
method.description: Same as [method SceneMultiplayer.disconnect_peer]. [method peer_kick] also tells the peer why.

method.name: display_declare
method.description: Interpolates the property [param track] of [param entity] with [param spec]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the track was declared ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST entity is not registered ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA track is empty, or spec is null ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE comp names no live node on entity [/codeblock]

method.name: display_get_param
method.description: Returns one display setting of [param entity], or [code]null[/code] when it has none.

method.name: display_get_track_stat
method.description: Returns the display diagnostic [param stat] of [param entity], or [code]null[/code] when unknown. Some stats describe one [param track], and the rest ignore it.

method.name: display_get_value
method.description: The last displayed value of [param track] on [param entity], or [code]null[/code] when there is none.

method.name: display_reset
method.description: Clears the interpolation buffer of [param entity] and snaps its visual to the current values. Call it after a teleport.

method.name: display_set_callback
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(entity, track, value)[/code] for every displayed value, in place of writing the node. An empty [Callable] clears it. Clears [method display_set_target_item].

method.name: display_set_param
method.description: Changes one display setting of [param entity]. [constant DISPLAY_PARAM_VISUAL_ROOT] takes a [NodePath].

method.name: display_set_target_item
method.description: Displays [param entity] on a [RenderingServer] canvas item or instance [param item] in place of a node. An invalid [RID] clears it. Clears [method display_set_callback].

method.name: display_snap
method.description: Sets [param track] on [param entity] to [param value] without interpolating.

method.name: display_write_rows_default
method.description: The default [method _display_write_rows]. Hands each value to the callback of [method display_set_callback] or the item of [method display_set_target_item] that its entity holds. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK every value was written ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST an entity holds no callback and no item, so the display writes its node ┖╴ERR_INVALID_DATA a value is neither a Transform2D nor a Transform3D [/codeblock]

method.name: endpoint_add
method.description: Adds a server at [param address] reached through [param transport], and notifies [constant ENDPOINT_ADDED]. Adding the same pair again returns the same [RID]. Returns an invalid [RID] when [param transport] is unknown. An empty [param address] is stored as the address a join with it reaches, so an ENet row reads [code]localhost[/code] and [method endpoint_find] finds it by either spelling. [codeblock] var endpoint := api.endpoint_add( api.transport_find(&"ENetMultiplayerPeer"), "203.0.113.42:21253") [/codeblock]

method.name: endpoint_find
method.description: Returns the endpoint for [param transport] and [param address], or an invalid [RID].

method.name: endpoint_get_param
method.description: Returns one field of [param endpoint], or [code]null[/code] when it does not exist.

method.name: endpoint_get_probe_interval
method.description: The flat form of [member NetwConnection.probe_interval].

method.name: endpoint_get_state
method.description: Returns what the last probe found for [param endpoint]. [constant ENDPOINT_STATE_STATUS] is [constant @GlobalScope.FAILED] until the first probe.

method.name: endpoint_is_browsing
method.description: The flat form of [member NetwConnection.browsing].

method.name: endpoint_join
method.description: The flat form of [method NetwConnection.join].

method.name: endpoint_list
method.description: Every known endpoint, the ones added with [method endpoint_add] first.

method.name: endpoint_probe
method.description: Checks whether [param endpoint] is reachable without joining it, then notifies [constant ENDPOINT_UPDATED]. Read the result with [method endpoint_get_state].

method.name: endpoint_remove
method.description: Removes [param endpoint] and notifies [constant ENDPOINT_REMOVED].

method.name: endpoint_set_browsing
method.description: The flat form of [member NetwConnection.browsing].

method.name: endpoint_set_param
method.description: Changes one field of [param endpoint] and notifies [constant ENDPOINT_UPDATED]. Only [constant ENDPOINT_PARAM_DISPLAY_NAME] can be changed. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the field changed ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the endpoint does not exist ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER param names anything but ENDPOINT_PARAM_DISPLAY_NAME [/codeblock]

method.name: endpoint_set_probe_interval
method.description: The flat form of [member NetwConnection.probe_interval].

method.name: entity_add_property_set
method.description: Synchronizes the properties in [param set] on the node [param comp] of [param entity]. [code]0[/code] is the entity's root node. Create [param set] with [method property_set_create] and seal it with [method property_set_seal] first. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the set was attached ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST entity or set does not exist ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the set is not sealed ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE comp is not a node of this entity ┖╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the session has no sync pipeline [/codeblock]

method.name: entity_admit
method.description: Gives [param entity] a new route, the id peers use to address it, and returns it. An entity that has one returns the same route. Returns [code]0[/code] on a client or for an unknown entity.

method.name: entity_adopt
method.description: Replicates a node that is already in the scene tree, and returns its entity. Returns an invalid [RID] on failure. Use [method entity_replicate] for a node that is not in the tree yet.

method.name: entity_bind_node
method.description: Makes [param node] the node of [param entity]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the node was bound, or already was ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST entity does not exist ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA node is null, or entity has no route yet ┖╴ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS a different node is already bound [/codeblock]

method.name: entity_bind_route
method.description: Gives [param entity] a route received from another peer. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the route was assigned ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST entity does not exist ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA route is not positive ┖╴ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE another entity has this route [/codeblock]

method.name: entity_call
method.description: Calls [param method] as an RPC on the node [param comp] of [param entity]. [param peer] [code]0[/code] sends it to every peer [method rpc_call] would. The method needs an [code]@rpc[/code] annotation or a [method Netw.configure_rpc] declaration. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the call was sent ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the node or the method does not exist ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the node is not ready on this peer yet ┖╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the method is not an RPC [/codeblock]

method.name: entity_create
method.description: Creates an empty entity. Give it a route with [method entity_admit] or [method entity_bind_route].

method.name: entity_describe
method.description: Returns what this peer knows about the entity at [param route], or an empty [Dictionary]. [code]stage[/code] is a [enum NetwEntity.Stage] and [code]liveness[/code] is an [enum EntityState]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴route int the route asked about ┠╴entity_id StringName the durable label ┠╴peer_id int the peer this entity represents, 0 for a server-owned one ┠╴stage int the entity's Stage ┠╴controller int the peer that steers it, 1 for the server ┠╴liveness int the entity's EntityState ┖╴layers Array the interest layers it belongs to, in join order [/codeblock]

method.name: entity_despawn
method.description: Despawns [param entity] on every peer. To hide it from one peer only, use [method interest_leave]. [param opts] sets options for this call. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the entity is despawning ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED called on a client ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the entity does not exist [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: entity_from_route
method.description: Returns the entity at [param route], or an invalid [RID].

method.name: entity_get_epoch
method.description: How many times the route of [param entity] has been reused by a new entity.

method.name: entity_get_node
method.description: Returns the node of [param entity], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: entity_get_parent
method.description: Returns the closest entity above [param entity] in the scene tree, or an invalid [RID].

method.name: entity_get_peer
method.description: Returns the peer that controls [param entity], or [code]0[/code].

method.name: entity_get_route
method.description: Returns the route of [param entity], the id every peer uses to address it, or [code]0[/code].

method.name: entity_get_state
method.description: Returns whether [param entity] is alive on this peer. An entity with no route returns [constant ENTITY_STATE_UNKNOWN].

method.name: entity_get_view
method.description: Returns the [NetwEntity] of [param entity], or [code]null[/code] once it is despawned.

method.name: entity_grant_control
method.description: Calls [method NetwEntity.transfer_control] on [param entity]. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param entity] has no bound node.

method.name: entity_of
method.description: Returns the entity of [param node] or of its closest ancestor that has one.

method.name: entity_replicate
method.description: Replicates [param node] and returns its entity, or an invalid [RID] on failure. Call it before [param node] enters the tree. Use [method entity_adopt] for a node already in the tree.

method.name: event_arm
method.description: Records every [enum Event] for [method event_ring] when [param enabled] is [code]true[/code]. When [code]false[/code], only events an [method event_watch] asks for are recorded.

method.name: event_ring
method.description: Returns and clears the events recorded for [param route], oldest first. Route [code]0[/code] holds events that belong to no entity. Each record has the shape shown in [method event_watch].

method.name: event_unwatch
method.description: Removes the watch [param id] returned by [method event_watch]. Returns [code]false[/code] when there was none.

method.name: event_watch
method.description:
Calls [param sink] with a record every time one of [param events] happens. Returns an id for [method event_unwatch]. [codeblock] var id := api.event_watch( [NetwMultiplayer.EVENT_DESPAWNED], {route = car_route}, {}, _on_despawn)
func _on_despawn(record: Dictionary) -> void: print(record.tick, " ", record.verdict) [/codeblock] [param target] filters by entity or peer. [param opts] accepts [code]once[/code], [code]dedupe[/code], [code]phase[/code] and [code]note[/code]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴route int only events about this entity ┠╴entity_id StringName the same, by entity id ┖╴peer int only events involving this peer [/codeblock] Every record has every key below. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴event int one value of Event ┠╴event_name String the name of that value ┠╴phase int 0 before the event, 1 after it ┠╴tick int the tick it happened on ┠╴route int the entity, 0 when none ┠╴entity_id StringName the entity id, empty if unknown ┠╴peer int the peer involved, 0 when none ┠╴verdict int the Error of a decision, OK otherwise ┠╴detail Dictionary extra values, keys depend on the event ┖╴model Dictionary the entity's last state, on despawn only [/codeblock]

method.name: event_watches
method.description: Every watch added with [method event_watch], with its id, events, filters, options and hit count.

method.name: get_authenticating_peers
method.description: Same as [method SceneMultiplayer.get_authenticating_peers].

method.name: interest_admits
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param peer] can see [param entity]. Returns [code]false[/code] when either is unknown.

method.name: interest_entity_has_filter
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param entity] is in any [NetwInterestLayer]. An entity in none is visible to every peer.

method.name: interest_explain
method.description: Returns a readable reason why [param peer] can or cannot see [param entity]. Use it for debugging, and do not compare against it.

method.name: interest_flush_now
method.description: Applies pending layer changes now, where they would otherwise apply at the end of the frame. [codeblock] layer.add_viewer(peer) api.interest_flush_now() assert(api.interest_admits(entity, peer)) [/codeblock] [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the changes were applied ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA a driver callback did not return an Array ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST a driver callback returned an unknown entity [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_get_membership
method.description: Returns every layer [param entity] is in.

method.name: interest_get_row
method.description: Returns a bitset with one bit per peer that can see [param entity]. Empty when the entity is unknown.

method.name: interest_is_filtered
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param entity] is in any layer. An entity in none is visible to every peer.

method.name: interest_join
method.description: Adds [param entity] to the layer [param layer_id]. Can be called before the node enters the tree.

method.name: interest_layer
method.description: Returns the layer called [param name], creating it on first use. Returns [code]null[/code] for a layer that belongs to a scene.

method.name: interest_layer_add_entity
method.description: Adds [param entity] to [param layer], so every viewer of the layer sees it. Applies at the end of the frame, or at [method interest_flush_now]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the entity will be added ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED called on a client ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the layer rejected the entity [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_add_viewer
method.description: Lets [param peer] see every entity in [param layer]. Applies at the end of the frame, or at [method interest_flush_now]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the peer will be added ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer does not exist ┖╴ERR_INVALID_DATA peer is 0 [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_create
method.description: Returns the layer called [param name], creating it if needed.

method.name: interest_layer_find
method.description: Returns the layer called [param name], or an invalid [RID]. Does not create it.

method.name: interest_layer_free
method.description: Deletes [param layer] with its viewers, entities, settings and callbacks.

method.name: interest_layer_ids
method.description: Returns a copy of the layer names added to [param entity] with [method interest_join].

method.name: interest_layer_named
method.description: Returns the layer called [param name], or [code]null[/code]. Does not create it. A layer that belongs to a scene returns [code]null[/code], so use [method Netw.scene] for it.

method.name: interest_layer_remove_entity
method.description: Removes [param entity] from [param layer], so its viewers stop seeing it. Applies at the end of the frame, or at [method interest_flush_now]. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the entity will be removed, or was not in the layer ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST layer or entity does not exist ┖╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED called on a client [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_layer_remove_viewer
method.description: Stops [param peer] from seeing [param layer]. Entities it still sees through another layer stay. The layer's [enum NetwInterestLayer.LeavePolicy] decides what happens to the rest.

method.name: interest_layer_set_driver_callback
method.description: Makes [param callback] decide which entities are in [param layer]. It runs once per frame with the layer's [RID] and returns the [RID] of every entity in it. An empty [Callable] removes it. [member NetwInterestLayer.driver] is the same with objects, and setting one replaces the other.

method.name: interest_layer_set_monitor_callback
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(visible, entity, peer_id)[/code] when an entity enters or leaves [param layer] for a peer, where [code]entity[/code] is an [RID]. [member NetwInterestLayer.monitor] is the same with objects, and setting one replaces the other.

method.name: interest_layer_set_param
method.description: Changes one setting of [param layer].

method.name: interest_layer_view
method.description: Returns [param layer] as a [NetwInterestLayer], or [code]null[/code]. A layer that belongs to a scene returns [code]null[/code], so use [method Netw.scene] for it.

method.name: interest_layers
method.description: Returns every [NetwInterestLayer] in this session, in no particular order.

method.name: interest_leave
method.description: Removes [param entity] from the layer [param layer_id].

method.name: interest_monitor_snapshot
method.description: Returns counts across every layer in this session. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴layers int number of layers ┠╴entities_filtered int entities in at least one layer ┠╴visible_edges int (entity, peer) pairs that can see each other ┠╴dirty_entities int entities with pending changes ┠╴relay_backlog int pending visibility updates to send ┠╴transitions_total int enters plus leaves since startup ┖╴vanished_dirty_skips int pending entities that left before applying [/codeblock]

method.name: interest_on_enter
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(layer_id, peer_id)[/code] when a peer starts seeing [param entity] through [param layer_id].

method.name: interest_on_leave
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(layer_id, peer_id)[/code] when a peer stops seeing [param entity] through [param layer_id].

method.name: interest_on_leave_policy
method.description: Sets the [enum NetwInterestLayer.LeavePolicy] for [param entity] on [param layer_id]. [constant NetwInterestLayer.LEAVE_POLICY_CUSTOM] requires [param custom_callback], called with [code](peer_id, layer_id)[/code] on the server. Other policies reject a callback.

method.name: interest_on_perception_policy
method.description: Sets what this peer does with [param entity] when its visibility through [param layer_id] changes. [constant NetwInterestLayer.PERCEPTION_POLICY_CUSTOM] requires [param custom_callback], called as [code]custom_callback(visible, peer_id, layer_id)[/code].

method.name: interest_player_sees
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the player [param peer_id] can see [param entity]. A host player follows the same rules as a client. A client can only ask about itself.

method.name: interest_resolved_layer_ids
method.description: Returns the sorted names of every layer [param entity] is in.

method.name: interest_shared_entities
method.description: Returns every other entity that shares the layer [param layer_id] with [param entity], sorted by [member NetwEntity.name]. An empty [param layer_id] checks every layer of [param entity].

method.name: interest_wire_admits
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when updates for [param entity] are sent to [param peer_id]. Always [code]true[/code] for the server, and [method interest_player_sees] for everyone else.

method.name: lagcomp_deny_action
method.description: Rejects the action [param key] from [param requester], which undoes its local effect.

method.name: lagcomp_effect_adopt
method.description: Confirms the effect [param key] and calls the [code]confirmed[/code] callbacks from [method lagcomp_effect_watch].

method.name: lagcomp_effect_arm
method.description: Starts a predicted effect [param key]. [param revert] runs if the server denies it or does not confirm it within [param timeout_ticks]. [code]0[/code] uses the default timeout.

method.name: lagcomp_effect_discard
method.description: Denies the effect [param key], runs its revert, and calls the [code]denied[/code] callbacks from [method lagcomp_effect_watch].

method.name: lagcomp_effect_key
method.description: Returns the key of the effect [param entity] started on [param tick]. [param slot] tells apart two effects on the same tick.

method.name: lagcomp_effect_pending
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the effect [param key] waits to be confirmed or denied.

method.name: lagcomp_effect_watch
method.description: Calls [param confirmed] or [param denied] when the effect [param key] resolves. Returns [code]false[/code] when the effect is not pending.

method.name: lagcomp_is_configured
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a [NetwLagCompensationConfig] was applied. Without one, rewinding does nothing.

method.name: lagcomp_metrics
method.description: Returns lag compensation counters. Totals count from startup. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴entities int entities simulated this tick ┠╴timelines int rewindable entities recorded this tick ┠╴corrections int total corrections ┠╴installs int total server states written onto simulated entities ┠╴max_replay_depth int most ticks replayed at once ┠╴consumed int total inputs the server used ┠╴missing int total input ticks that never arrived ┠╴folded int physics frames merged into an existing input ┠╴joint Dictionary totals for bodies simulated together ┠╴pending_actions int actions waiting to run ┠╴effects_armed int effects waiting to be confirmed or denied ┖╴gate_fallbacks int actions that ran without all their state [/codeblock]

method.name: lagcomp_rewind
method.description: Moves every entity in [param entities] back to where it was at [param tick], calls [param body], then moves them back. Entities with no history at [param tick] are skipped. [method Netw.rewind] does the same with [NetwEntity] values.

method.name: lagcomp_sample
lagcomp_timeline_declare
method.description: Starts recording the history of [param entity] so it can be rewound. The server already does this for entities with synchronized state. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK recording started ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the entity has no node [/codeblock]

method.name: lagcomp_timeline_undeclare
method.description: Stops recording the history of [param entity].

method.name: liveness_allocate_route
method.description: Returns the route bound to [param wrapper]. Reserves and binds a route when needed. Repeated calls for one entity return the same route.

method.name: liveness_bind_route
method.description: Gives [param route] to [param wrapper] and notifies [constant ENTITY_LIVE].

method.name: liveness_claim_routes
method.description: Creates [param count] routes with no node attached, for example to address table rows. Release them with [method liveness_release_routes]. Returns an empty array on a client. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: liveness_get_entities
method.description: Every live [NetwEntity] on this peer, sorted by route.

method.name: liveness_get_routes
method.description: Every live route on this peer, in no particular order.

method.name: liveness_node_of
method.description: Returns the node at [param route], or [code]null[/code] once it is freed.

method.name: liveness_pending_live_count
method.description: How many [method liveness_when_live] callbacks are still waiting.

method.name: liveness_poll_now
method.description: Times out the [method liveness_when_live] callbacks whose deadline has passed.

method.name: liveness_release_routes
method.description: Releases [param routes] from [method liveness_claim_routes], removes their table rows, and tells every peer. A released route is never reused. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the routes were released ┖╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED called on a client [/codeblock]

method.name: liveness_reserve_route
method.description: Returns a new route without attaching anything to it. Routes are never reused.

method.name: liveness_route_of
method.description: The route bound to [param wrapper], or [code]0[/code].

method.name: liveness_route_state
method.description: The [enum EntityState] of [param route].

method.name: liveness_when_live
method.description: Calls [param callback] once [param route] has an entity. Calls [param on_timeout] instead after [param timeout_ticks]. [code]0[/code] waits one second.

method.name: observe
method.description: Calls [param callback] every time [param event] happens, with the arguments listed at that [enum Notification] value. Observing the same pair twice keeps one subscription. [codeblock] Netw.of(self).observe(NetwMultiplayer.PEER_KICKED, func(reason: String) -> void: print("kicked: ", reason) ) [/codeblock] Most games use the signals of [NetwSession], [NetwClock] and [NetwEntity] instead.

method.name: of
method.description: Returns the session [param node] belongs to, or [code]null[/code] when it is outside the tree.

method.name: peer_ack
method.description: The newest packet sequence [param peer] acknowledged, or [code]-1[/code] when none.

method.name: peer_forget
method.description: Forgets everything about [param peer], including its [NetwPlayer]. It does not disconnect it. Use [method disconnect_peer] for that.

method.name: peer_get_bucket
method.description:
Returns an instance of [param bucket_type] stored for [param peer], created on first use. Use it to keep game data per peer. [codeblock] class Bucket extends RefCounted: var ready := false
var bucket := api.peer_get_bucket(peer, Bucket) as Bucket [/codeblock] [param bucket_type] must create a [RefCounted]. Returns [code]null[/code] for an unknown peer. [method peer_forget] deletes the bucket.

method.name: peer_get_player
method.description: Returns the [NetwPlayer] of [param peer], or [code]null[/code] until its join is accepted.

method.name: peer_has_bucket
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param peer] has a [param bucket_type] bucket. Does not create one.

method.name: peer_join_address
method.description: The address other players use to join this session, such as a host and port for [ENetMultiplayerPeer] or a lobby id. Empty when there is none.

method.name: peer_kick
method.description: Disconnects [param peer_id]. When [param reason] is not empty, that peer receives [constant PEER_KICKED] first. Does nothing on a client.

method.name: peer_link_stats
method.description: Returns measured connection quality to [param peer], and what this peer's byte budget sends it. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴loss float share of the last 32 packets lost ┠╴rtt float round trip time, in seconds ┠╴jitter float round trip variation, in seconds ┠╴reorders int packets that arrived out of order ┠╴duplicates int packets that arrived twice ┠╴mode String "good", or "bad" while its budget is cut ┠╴budget_bits int most bits one packet to this peer may use ┠╴budget_bytes int bytes it may be sent each tick ┠╴sent_bytes int bytes charged to it since it joined ┠╴debt_bytes int bytes it was sent past its budget ┖╴deferred_rows int rows left waiting by the last tick [/codeblock] Losing packets halves [code]budget_bytes[/code] and [code]budget_bits[/code]. Each round trip without loss adds back an eighth of the configured budget, stopping an eighth short of the rate that lost packets for the next minute. While [code]debt_bytes[/code] is above zero, volatile properties wait, and retained properties and RPCs still go.

method.name: peer_request_kick
method.description: Asks the server to kick [param peer_id]. The server receives [constant PEER_KICK_REQUESTED] and decides. [b]Player request.[/b]

method.name: persist_flush_all
method.description: Saves every persistent entity that changed. The promise resolves with [constant @GlobalScope.OK], or the first error. See [method NetwSession.save_entities] for the errors. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: persist_get_record_id
method.description: The key [param entity] is saved under, or empty when it is not persistent.

method.name: persist_is_dirty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a saved property of [param entity] changed since the last save.

method.name: persist_load
method.description: Loads the saved properties of [param entity]. The promise resolves with [code]true[/code] when a save was found. See [method NetwPersistence.load] for the errors. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: persist_save
method.description: Saves the persistent properties of [param entity]. The promise resolves with [code]false[/code] when nothing changed. See [method NetwPersistence.save] for the errors. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: persist_tick_default
method.description:
The default [method _persist_tick]. Saves every changed entity whose [method NetwPersistenceConfig.interval] has passed. Does nothing on a client. [codeblock] extends NetwMultiplayer
func _persist_tick(delta: float) -> void: if not saving_paused: persist_tick_default(delta) [/codeblock]

method.name: player_bodies
method.description: Every entity that belongs to the player of [param peer], in no particular order.

method.name: player_kick
method.description: Removes [param player] from the session and disconnects their peer with [param reason]. Notifies [constant PLAYER_LEFT] first. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the player was kicked ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED called on a client ┖╴ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER unknown player, or the server's own player [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: predict_admit_frame_default
method.description: The default [method _predict_admit_frame]. Rejects packets for unknown entities, and inputs from a peer that does not control the entity. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the packet is accepted ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST unknown route ┠╴ERR_SKIP the entity is despawning ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the entity has no node ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA payload is empty ┖╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this sender may not send this packet [/codeblock]

method.name: predict_consume
method.description: Calls [method _predict_consume] when overridden, and [method predict_consume_default] otherwise.

method.name: predict_consume_default
method.description: The default [method _predict_consume]. Returns [constant NetwPrediction.CONSUME_ACTION_REPLAY] when more than [param buffer] inputs are queued, [constant NetwPrediction.CONSUME_ACTION_HOLD] when fewer, and [constant NetwPrediction.CONSUME_ACTION_STARVED] when none.

method.name: predict_declare
method.description: Turns on prediction for [param entity] with the settings in [member NetwEntity.prediction]. It also turns on lag compensation. Calling it again does nothing. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK prediction is on ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the entity does not exist ┖╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE a NetwLagCompensationConfig is not applied yet [/codeblock]

method.name: predict_drive_default
method.description: The default [method _predict_drive].

method.name: predict_engine_seated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when this peer predicts [param entity]. Entities controlled by other peers usually return [code]false[/code].

method.name: predict_evaluate_default
method.description: The default [method _predict_evaluate].

method.name: predict_flush_tap
method.description: Writes the buffered prediction log to disk now. It is also written every second.

method.name: predict_get_param
method.description: Returns one prediction setting of [param entity], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: predict_get_stats
method.description: Returns the [member NetwPrediction.stats] of [param entity], or [code]null[/code] when it does not predict.

method.name: predict_get_stepper
method.description: Returns the [NetwPhysicsStepper] installed on the physics [param space], or [code]null[/code]. Without one, [constant NetwSimulation.SCHEDULE_STEPPED] runs as [constant NetwSimulation.SCHEDULE_FRAME].

method.name: predict_get_tap_cost
method.description: Returns what the prediction log has cost so far, or an empty [Dictionary] when it is off. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴bytes int bytes written ┠╴lines int lines written ┠╴drains int how many times it was written out ┖╴mean_drain_usec float average time of one write, in microseconds [/codeblock]

method.name: predict_recover_default
method.description: The default [method _predict_recover]. A correction that does not replay adds the difference between [param payload] and [param predicted] to [param current].

method.name: predict_set_correction_path_callback
method.description: Sets [member NetwPrediction.correction_path_clear] on [param entity].

method.name: predict_set_input_callback
method.description: Sets [member NetwPrediction.predict_input] on [param entity].

method.name: predict_set_param
method.description: Changes one prediction setting of [param entity].

method.name: predict_set_sensor_callback
method.description: Adds [param callback] to [member NetwPrediction.sensors] of [param entity] under [param name]. An empty [Callable] removes it.

method.name: predict_set_witness_callback
method.description: Sets [member NetwPrediction.witness_contacts] on [param entity].

method.name: predict_stepper_install
method.description: Lets [param stepper] step the physics [param space] in place of [code]PhysicsServer3D.space_step[/code], for a physics server without it. A [code]null[/code] [param stepper], or one whose [method NetwPhysicsStepper._can_step] returns [code]false[/code], removes the stepper of [param space]. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param space] is not valid. [method NetwSession.install_physics_stepper] does the same from a [World3D].

method.name: predict_undeclare
method.description: Turns off prediction for [param entity].

method.name: property_path
method.description: Returns the path to [param property] of [param source], relative to [param base], such as [code]"Body:position"[/code]. Empty when either node is freed.

method.name: property_set_add_column
method.description: Adds the schema's [param column] to [param set] and returns its index. Returns [code]-1[/code] when the set is sealed, the column is unknown, or already added.

method.name: property_set_create
method.description: Creates an empty set of synchronized properties for [param schema]. Add properties with [method property_set_add_column], then call [method property_set_seal]. Returns an invalid [RID] when [param schema] is unknown or has an array column.

method.name: property_set_get_wire_hash
method.description: A hash of the properties of [param set] and their order. Two peers with the same hash read each other's packets correctly. Returns [code]0[/code] for an unknown set.

method.name: property_set_seal
method.description: Locks [param set] so no more properties can be added. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK the set was sealed ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST the set does not exist [/codeblock]

method.name: rpc_call
method.description: Calls [param callable] with [param args] as an RPC on [param peer], or on every peer from [method rpc_get_recipients] when [param peer] is [code]0[/code]. The node must belong to an entity, and the method must be an RPC. A [NetwEntity] in [param args] arrives as the receiver's own [NetwEntity].

method.name: rpc_channel_register
method.description: Calls [param handler] as [code]handler(entity, payload, sender)[/code] for every packet on [param channel], which must be between 100 and 254. When [param defer_when_unknown] is [code]true[/code], a packet for an entity that is not spawned yet waits for it.

method.name: rpc_get_recipients
method.description: Returns the peers an RPC on [param entity] is sent to, which is every connected peer except this one. Offline, it returns [code][1][/code]. Use [method interest_player_sees] to ask who can see the entity.

method.name: rpc_request_call
method.description: Calls [param callable] on [param peer] and returns a [NetwPromise] that resolves with its return value. The promise is rejected after [param timeout_seconds]. Returns [code]null[/code] when [method rpc_call] would reject the call.

method.name: rpc_request_call_group
method.description: Calls [param callable] on every peer that sees its entity, and returns a [NetwGroupPromise] of their replies. A peer that disconnects counts as rejected. Returns [code]null[/code] when [method rpc_request_call] would.

method.name: rpc_send_reply
method.description: Replies [param value] to request [param txn] from [param peer].

method.name: scene_change_to_file

A declaration that mixes reliable and unreliable properties makes two entries. [codeblock lang=text] Array[Dictionary] ┖╴entry ┠╴table RID what _sync_gather_rows receives as table ┠╴family String "volatile", "retained" or "window" ┠╴columns Array per property, its name, type and port ┠╴rows int nodes that declare it ┠╴dirty int rows whose values changed at the latest read ┠╴bytes int memory the entry holds ┖╴retention int past values kept per row [/codeblock] A [code]port[/code] of [code]"body"[/code] reads a rigid body's position, rotation, velocities and sleeping state from the physics server, and skips a body that slept through this tick and the last one. [code]"engine"[/code] and [code]"script"[/code] read the node's property on every tick. Set the environment variable [code]NETW_STORE_VALIDATE[/code] to a number of ticks to check the skipped bodies. method.name: sync_explain

[codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴verdict String one of the values below ┠╴tick int the tick of the last send ┠╴confirmed int the newest version the peer confirmed ┠╴exposed int the newest version sent ┠╴has_baseline bool whether only changes can be sent ┠╴priority float how far up the queue it has climbed while waiting ┠╴class String what it climbs by each tick, see below ┖╴age_ticks int ticks since the last send, -1 before the first [/codeblock] [code]class[/code] is [code]"player"[/code] for an entity bound to a player, [code]"interacting"[/code] while a claim is pending, its [member NetwEntity.hold] is set, or its controller changed in the last second, [code]"moving"[/code] when it changed in the last 8 ticks, and [code]"resting"[/code] otherwise and for every refresh. They climb by 10000, 1000, 100 and 1 each tick, times [member NetwEntity.replication_priority]. [code]verdict[/code] is [code]"sent"[/code] when the last pass carried it, [code]"deferred"[/code] while the peer is still owed a change, [code]"caught_up"[/code] when the peer already has everything, [code]"ungathered"[/code] when nothing was read, or [code]"unoffered"[/code] when it is not sent to this peer.
